recipe.title: Cheese scones
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Sophie Gray ("Destitute Gourmet").

i.n: cheese, grated (plus extra cheese to top)

method.s: Combine the flour, cheese and any other seasoning ingredients you like. Mix well.
Add the milk - the dough will be quite wet.
Shape into small loaves or balls, then sprinkle with extra cheese.
Bake for 10 minutes, until well risen and crusty.
